_comment: Balance guardrail bands for the balance suite in tests/run.js. Deterministic seeded sim (seed below, real-time loop frozen, audio muted): greedy-buying bot tapping 8x/s, in-game minutes. onScreenAvg and focusTTK are averaged over the 3 minutes ending at each checkpoint. Baseline at v1.0.0 (2026-11-17): min5 wave 19 / onScreen 11.8 / TTK 0.90s; min15 wave 34 / 18.2 / 1.65s; min30 wave 45 / 16.1 / 3.36s; warp +13 DM; idle best wave 10 at 15 min. Daily updates must NOT edit this file (CI blocks it on daily-update PRs): fix the balance instead, or propose band changes in a separate PR for the owner to review.
